brief: Over-caffeinated nervous young male junior engineer live on a demo stream, very fast Californian speech, voice cracks when excited, nervous laughter, overselling everything

lines.v_devin_line: Hi, I'm Devin, the first AI software engineer. Allegedly.
lines.v_devin_intro: Estimated time to beat you: forty-five minutes.
lines.v_devin_winq: PR merged. Please don't look at the tests.
lines.v_devin_hurt2: CI is red! CI is RED!
lines.v_devin_ko: I need a senior engineer! Anyone!
lines.v_devin_special: Spawning a sub-agent! He's also me!
lines.v_devin_taunt0: I've planned this fight. It has thirty seven steps. I'm on step two.
lines.v_devin_taunt1: Don't worry, I'll open a pull request to fix your guard.
lines.v_devin_taunt2: My sub-agent is also punching you. Parallelism!
lines.v_devin_pain0: Ouch! Logging that as a known issue!
lines.v_devin_low0: Asking for human review! Please! Anyone! Senior engineer!
lines.v_devin_winq1: Ticket closed. Won't fix: your defense.
lines.v_devin_winq2: Five hundred dollars per month. Worth it. Allegedly.
